name: Mailopoly Inbox
description:
Mailopoly is your unified inbox — one place for everything that reaches you. Today it brings all your email accounts together — Gmail, Outlook, Apple, Yahoo and any IMAP mailbox, including multiple accounts of each — into a single view, filters the noise into a clean personal feed (the Cleanbox), and extracts what matters: tasks, replies owed, invoices with amounts and due dates, deliveries, and events. This connector gives your assistant that same understanding — designed to be the one place you check, whatever the message and wherever it comes from.

One connection covers all of it. Ask for "emails about the lease" and Mailopoly searches every account at once (with deep search for harder, semantic queries); ask "catch me up" for a briefing on what you missed; ask "what's on my day" for one list aggregated across every inbox; ask "what bills are due" and the amounts and due dates are already extracted. My Data widgets surface bills, deliveries, replies owed and more at a glance. With write access your assistant manages tasks, reminders, custom email lists and drafts; with send access it sends through your own connected address — never a relay.

Permissions are yours: read, write and send are separate grants chosen on a Mailopoly consent screen, enforced server-side on every request, revocable in one click from Settings → Security. Every tool call is audit-logged to your account. Mailopoly is SOC 2 Type II certified and a Google-verified OAuth application. Requires a Mailopoly account — free trial available, no card needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mailopoly Inbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mailopoly Inbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fastapi.prod.aws.mailopoly.com/mcp-server. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mailopoly Inbox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mailopoly Inbox lists 39 MCP tools, including about_mailopoly, add_email_to_list, check_email_sync, complete_task, create_email_list, create_task, create_task_rule, deep_search_emails, delete_task_rule, get_account_overview, get_action_links, and get_catch_up.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mailopoly Inbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mailopoly Inbox in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Mailopoly Inbox MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mailopoly Inbox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mailopoly Inbox is developed by Mailopoly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
